scope: Two read-only Debian ARM64 VMs under TCG, production gateway processes and firewall, native loopback SOCKS/TLS fixture and Python chat peer. No real provider or Tor tools traffic.

checks: startup has no Tor daemon, Tor state, selected route or IP traffic
SOCKS selection starts the expected grant processes, with distinct unprivileged UIDs and one firewall endpoint
valid grant streams verified HTTPS through SOCKS with remote domain resolution; invalid grant never contacts the proxy
tools reject invalid tokens, denied/ask/unknown destinations, wrong ports and private addresses before contacting SOCKS
tools HTTP and verified client-side HTTPS cross the real supervisor, firewall and policy connector without API key or local proxy headers at the destination
compromised chat cannot forward; API/tools/Tor UIDs cannot use external SOCKS; API/tools/connector cannot bypass through local Tor
unoffered authentication methods, rejected credentials and CONNECT errors fail without TLS, retries or fallback
a stopped SOCKS listener returns provider_unavailable without an alternative route
proxy recovery keeps the chosen route; revocation closes the API listener and the next grant rejects the previous token
revoke closes both active tools HTTP and CONNECT/TLS streams at the external peer and chat
revoke closes an established upstream TLS stream and the chat response
shutdown removes all grant processes and route permissions; SOCKS never starts or writes Tor state
full outside capture contains only TCP to the configured proxy, no cleartext API key or local token, no DNS/UDP/IPv6; VM consoles contain no secrets

limits: The Python peer does not prove Bun/OpenCode webfetch or shell proxy compatibility.
This commit predates host policy persistence, trusted manager editing and host grant integration.
Interactive ask, approval expiry and revocation of individual permissions are not implemented.
TCG laboratory results do not establish hardware isolation or the behavior of an arbitrary remote SOCKS proxy.
This report does not diagnose the earlier host console reopening failure.
